_note: Where each product in pesticides.json is registered on rice, maize, cotton and soybean, read by hand from the CIB&RC major-uses lists in data/raw/cibrc/ (as on 30.09.2026); `line` is where the product's block starts in that file. The spray check gives no objection only when the register lists the product for the crop and a pest naming the target (or our own advice uses it there). Rules applied when reading: a register entry's own words decide the target — 'stem borer' on rice covers yellow and white stem borer, a bare 'bollworm(s)' is the American bollworm and pink bollworm counts only where named, and a bare 'leaf spot' or 'leaf blight' is not taken to cover a disease it does not name (as in DATASETS.md §3b); rows that belong to a neighbouring product in the PDF are not counted; a seed-treatment-only row is not counted as a spray use when the same product has spray rows on that crop (carbendazim on sheath blight). Products absent here are not on the register for these crops: copper oxychloride 50% WP, metalaxyl 8% + mancozeb 64% WP and the two herbicides.
